visual_identity.pattern_strategy: High-contrast zebra-like banding on the flippers only; solid dark charcoal body running continuously along its horizontal profile.
visual_identity.integument: Thick, armor-like skin on the dorsal side, mapped uniformly across its full horizontal lateral flank.
visual_identity.facial_silhouette: Strict side-profile view configured to display the animal's maximum horizontal length for accurate top-by-bottom size comparisons. The comically blunt, short snout is oriented perfectly to face laterally in the frame.

pose: The robust pliosaurid is oriented entirely in a strict lateral profile view, swimming horizontally from left to right parallel to the frame boundaries. The original aggressive forward lunge and front-facing wide mouth are unrolled and stabilized into a flat, level, straight cruising path, extending its blunt pitbull-like head, short neck, powerful heavy torso, limbs (flattened toward the camera plane), and tail end-to-end to cleanly track alongside the central UI measuring tape system.
